title: Third season on this board and it still feels new
body: Bought this after demoing one at Whistler and it has held up through three full seasons. The base still takes wax well and the edges have kept their bite after a few rock strikes. If you ride mixed terrain and only want one board this is the one I would pick again.

title: Great all-rounder but size up if you are between
body: Really pleased with it overall. Stable at speed and forgiving enough that I could work on switch riding without catching an edge every run. Only note is that the sizing runs about half a size short for me so I would size up if you are between two.

title: Handles chop far better than the price suggests
body: I was expecting to feel every bump given what I paid but it stays composed through afternoon chop. Landed a few flat landings I would rather not talk about and it absorbed them fine.

title: Perfect first board
body: My instructor recommended something in this range and it has been ideal. Predictable, easy to turn, and I have not once felt like the board was ahead of me. Two months in and I am linking turns on blues.

title: Good board, disappointing bindings hardware
body: No complaints about the board itself, it rides well and holds an edge. But two of the binding screws stripped within the first week and I had to source replacements locally. Would be four or five stars with better hardware.

title: Fast base and it stayed fast
body: The sintered base is genuinely quick and it has kept its glide better than my last board which needed a grind after one season. Worth the extra over an extruded base if you ride flatter resorts.

title: Stable for filming laps
body: I shoot a lot of follow cam and needed something I could ride one handed without drama. This is stable at moderate speed and turns without much input which is exactly what I wanted. Slightly heavier than I expected.

title: Edge hold on ice is the best I have had
body: We get a lot of hardpack here and most boards chatter. This one tracks. I took it out on a genuinely icy morning and it held a clean carve where my old board would have washed out.

title: Does everything well without being exciting
body: Solid, dependable, no bad habits. It is not the most playful board I have owned but it does not do anything wrong either. If you want one board that works everywhere this is a sensible pick.

title: Delaminated at the tail after six weeks
body: Rode it maybe fifteen days and the topsheet started lifting at the tail. Support were responsive and are sorting a replacement so I am not writing the brand off, but I cannot rate the board itself above two stars given it did not last a season.

title: Light enough for hiking
body: I do a fair bit of sidecountry hiking and the weight difference is noticeable by the third lap. Still stiff enough to hold on the way back down.

title: Simple and it works
body: Nothing flashy about it and that is the appeal. Good flex for park laps, easy to press, and it has taken a season of rails without much complaint beyond the usual base scratches.

title: Better than boards costing twice as much
body: Genuinely surprised. I have ridden much more expensive boards that were less fun. Pop is there, it holds an edge, and it did not fall apart the first time I hit something hard.

title: Fine board, sizing chart is misleading
body: The board rides well enough but the sizing guidance did not match reality for me. I ordered to the chart and ended up with something noticeably short. Rides fine now that I have adjusted my stance but worth checking before ordering.

title: Exactly what I wanted for powder days
body: Floats properly without me having to lean back the whole run. First deep day I took it out I did not think about the board once which is the highest compliment I can give.

title: Lovely in soft snow, less so on hardpack
body: On a powder morning it is superb. On a firm afternoon it is noticeably less confident and I found myself backing off. Know what you are buying and it is excellent.

title: Held up to a full season of everything
body: Rode it in slush, ice, powder and one memorably bad rain day. It has scratches but nothing structural and it still rides like it did in November.

title: Stiffer than expected in the best way
body: I ride aggressively and most boards this price feel vague at speed. This does not. It rewards a bit of effort and stays planted when you push it.

title: Great carving board with one caveat
body: Carves beautifully and the edge hold is genuinely good. Caveat is that it is demanding — my partner borrowed it for a day and found it a lot of work. Not a beginner board.

title: Bought a second one for my partner
body: Rode mine for two weeks and then ordered another for my partner rather than looking at anything else. That is about as strong a recommendation as I have.

title: Solid park board
body: Takes a beating on rails and boxes without much damage to the base. Slightly softer than I would like for larger jumps but for a park lap it is great.

title: Confidence inspiring for an intermediate
body: I moved to this from a rental and the difference was immediate. It does what I ask and nothing I do not ask, which when you are still learning is worth a lot.

title: Arrived with a cracked edge
body: The board was damaged on arrival — a visible crack in the edge near the nose. To be fair the replacement process was quick and the second board has been fine, but the first one should never have shipped.

title: The only wax I use now
body: Goes on easily, lasts longer than the brand I used before, and does not need a hot iron to be worth it. Have been through three tins.

title: Good wax, wish the tin were bigger
body: Works well across a decent temperature range and I have not needed a separate warm and cold wax this season. Only gripe is that the tin runs out faster than I would like.

title: Noticeably faster on flat runouts
body: Sceptical about whether wax makes a real difference on a mid range board but the flat runout back to the lift used to require skating and now it does not.

title: Well made and it has lasted
body: Two seasons and it is still going. Some cosmetic wear on the topsheet but nothing that affects how it rides. Would buy again.

title: Turned up faster than promised
body: Ordered on a Tuesday and it was with me by Thursday which I did not expect. Board itself is excellent — quick edge to edge and lighter than my last one.
